name: PratikshPandita/consumer-complaint-root-cause-analytics
what_it_holds: SQL/Python analytics repo built on the public CFPB consumer-complaints dataset, using BigQuery for root-cause trend analysis plus a validation framework for a text-classification model's output. Updated 13 Sep 2026 (same day as this scout run), 0 stars, no license listed.
why_useful: Shows a working BigQuery-based ingestion/query pattern against the full CFPB complaints public dataset (which is queryable by company name, so 'Airbnb' complaints could be isolated); useful as a template method even though it ships no committed Airbnb-specific extract.

name: cfpb-complaints-database
what_it_holds: LA Times Data Desk's committed copy of the full CFPB Consumer Complaints Database as downloaded 25 April 2018 - a frozen point-in-time snapshot (not a live API pull) of what was at the time ~1M+ consumer financial complaints across all products/companies nationwide.
why_useful: This is exactly the kind of point-in-time vintage the brief wants (gap #4): a dated, immutable complaint-database snapshot from 2018 that can be diffed against a fresh 2026 CFPB pull to see how Airbnb-BNPL-adjacent (Affirm/Klarna) complaint volume and travel/lodging-merchant complaint mentions have grown, without any lookback bias.
